integrity: All equilibrium, Jacobian, determinant-factorization and Routh-Hurwitz identities are reconstructed from the displayed equations with exact rational arithmetic. The reported source numbers are retained as published comparison data rather than silently altered.
scientific_limitations: The result treats the coefficients actually printed in equation (5.1) and establishes the first linear characteristic crossing. The prose parameter list immediately above (5.1) is inconsistent with the displayed natural-removal coefficient, and the nonlinear first Lyapunov coefficient at the corrected crossing is not recomputed.
title: An exact population mode corrects the first-delay crossing in a synthetic-drug DDE
